text:
Anya: Anyone watching the late match? my fantasy captain went nuclear, 28 pts in one half 🤯
Matt: Wait what — who did you captain? spill the lineup!
Anya: Put the armband on R. Delgado. Benchwarmer last week, hero tonight.
Sam: Delgado? I dropped him last month, oof.
Jordan: That’s the problem with fantasy — momentum is a cruel mistress.
Priya: Also, taco bet reminder: winner of the office pool gets free tacos tomorrow. Who’s in? :taco: :raised_hands:
Matt: I call dibs on steak tacos if we’re doing it right.
Anya: I’ll bring salsas and napkins. Sam you on chip duty?
Sam: Chips + guac. Splurge mode.
Jordan: I’ll Venmo the taco fund later. 
Priya: quick poll — spicy salsa or mild? Reply with :fire: for spicy, :chili_pepper: for mild.
Matt: :fire:
Sam: :chili_pepper:
Anya: :fire: unless Jordan is cooking (then mild).
OpsBot: Match update — 90'+3: Final score Riverhawks 3 — 2 Westbridge.
Jordan: literally refreshed the scoreboard 17 times during stoppage. wild.
Anya: Fantasy points already posted, captain bonus applied.
Sam: Can someone paste the lineup? I wanna study your bad decisions.
Anya: Sure —
```
GK: H. Ortega
DEF: Lee, Ramos, P. Silva
MID: Delgado (c), N. Abara, J. Kim
FWD: Torres, M. Soto, L. Vega
```
Matt: Good lord that Delgado haul carried the whole squad.
Priya: Vote results: spicy wins 2-1. Tacos will be spicy.
Jordan: I’ll bring some cooling yogurt dip for the brave.
Anya: Great — taco victory party at 12pm in kitchen. See you there :tada:
Sam: Also, 0 regrets on dropping Delgado earlier — I did it for the greater good (of my bench spots). :sweat_smile:
Matt: Next week’s matchup predictions thread when? Friday night?
Anya: Friday night works. Maybe we do wings vs tacos debate.
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: Kitchen reserved 11:50-12:30 for "Taco Reward" — organizer: Anya.
Jordan: Awesome. Thanks team!
